# RELION vs relax benchmarks

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_benchmark_table.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Per-row provenance, jobs, notes and per-run comparisons: [provenance](relion_vs_relax_provenance.md) (updated 2026-09-25).

Resolution cells read unmasked / masked (Å); the letter names the unmasked definition, the masked value is relion_postprocess with the dataset's frozen mask. Masked X-AUC: masked FSC-AUC of relax against RELION. Ratio: relax wall / RELION wall.

- **a**: unmasked half-map FSC, first three-shell-sustained crossing below 1/7
- **b**: unmasked half-map FSC 0.143 of the final unfiltered half maps
- **c**: relion_postprocess unmasked FSC 0.143 of the final half maps
- **d**: the engine's own last-iteration estimate (for Class3D not a gold-standard FSC)
- **f**: InitialModel: FSC 0.5 of the registered final map against the reference (K>1: most populated class)

Matched:

- **yes**: both arms in one job on the same node and GPU model (or ABBA repeats); the ratio is a speed comparison
- **workload**: same GPU model and workload, timing not controlled (separate jobs, nodes or dates)
- **no**: workload, schedule or CPU layout differs, or a wall is missing; the ratio is not a speed comparison
